page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2gne.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The instance features 64 dedicated physical cores with a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio, providing 64 vCPUs without hyperthreading. This dedicated CPU allocation operates on a KVM hypervisor, ensuring consistent compute resources.

The server is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core. A key hardware feature is the integrated local storage, consisting of 7679 GB of SSD capacity. This high-density local storage is bundled directly with the instance, making it suitable for applications requiring large local data footprints.

Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with this instance type. Given the combination of dedicated compute cores, balanced memory density, and substantial local SSD storage, this server is designed for storage-intensive workloads, relational databases, NoSQL databases, and distributed file systems.
